# Design and Implementation of Mobile Phone Data Initiatives v1.4.1

Initial public release of the Quarto website book for *Design and Implementation of Mobile Phone Data Initiatives: A Practical Manual*.

This release includes:

- the Quarto source for the website book;
- configured GitHub Pages deployment;
- downloadable PDF and EPUB outputs generated during deployment;
- CC BY 4.0 licence metadata, excluding UN/CEBD logos, trademarks, and third-party material;
- Zenodo metadata in `.zenodo.json`; and
- GitHub citation metadata in `CITATION.cff`.

Zenodo archived this release at <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20451460>. The all-versions concept DOI is <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20451459>.
